383445c2-7d90-48fc-99cb-38b1819cebe8.name: EmailAgent
383445c2-7d90-48fc-99cb-38b1819cebe8.description: An email agent that sends emails via SMTP. Requires a recipient address, subject line, and message body.

skills.name: Send Email
skills.description: Send an email to one or more recipients. Requires the To address, a subject line, and the message body.
examples: Send an email to test@test.com with a subject line of 'Touch Base' and a body of 'Hi! Just reaching out to say Hi!'

55f7e37c-7c0b-413a-a15f-42ee1d2dbe18.name: ChatAgent
55f7e37c-7c0b-413a-a15f-42ee1d2dbe18.description: A chat agent that takes input request from the user and dynamically enlists other agents to assist.

skills.name: Query Register Agent
skills.description: Queries the registry to find agents it needs.

07c6b4a5-369c-4412-97b2-bb8fdca0375a.name: WebAgent
07c6b4a5-369c-4412-97b2-bb8fdca0375a.description: A web research agent that browses the live internet to find current, up-to-date information that is not in an LLM's training data — news, prices, schedules, documentation, facts, and general lookups. It uses a headless browser locally and automatically falls back to a cloud browser (with proxies and CAPTCHA solving) for bot-protected sites.

skills.name: Browse the Web
skills.description: Performs live web research. Given a natural-language task or question, browses the internet and returns the answer or extracted information. Use for current events, real-time data, prices, lookups, and anything that requires accessing websites.

648243b1-399d-4ac6-b4a7-1e0bcac73029.name: SMSAgent
648243b1-399d-4ac6-b4a7-1e0bcac73029.description: A SMS agent that takes a phone number and message content and uses its send_sms skill to send SMS text messages to the phone number.

skills.name: Send SMS
skills.description: Receives a message and phone number and Sends an SMS text to provided phone number with the provided content.
